newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev idles near 1,570 to dlr in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev idles near 1,570 to dlr in thin trade.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev idled at 1,569-1,571 per dollar at 0750 GMT in very light volume on the local interbank market, a touch firmer from the opening's 1,569-1,572 and was expected to trade stable, dealers said.
"Foreign currency supply runs high because banks and companies still need levs for wage and tax payment due by the end of the month but demand is rather low," one dealer said.
The lev closed at 1,568-1,573 on Monday.

Trade was expected to be lacklustre and rangebound near 1,570 and a lev rise was likely unless the central bank started bidding for foreign currency to compensate the low demand from banks and clients, traders said.
The central bank has not been spotted on the market this morning so far.
